mapper.sql: outbox_id, channel, recipient_user_id, business_key, payload_json, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, last_result, last_error, version, created_time, updated_time

o.outbox_id as outbox_id, o.channel as channel, o.recipient_user_id as recipient_user_id, o.business_key as business_key, o.payload_json as payload_json, o.status as status, o.retry_count as retry_count, o.next_retry_time as next_retry_time, o.last_result as last_result, o.last_error as last_error, o.version as version, o.created_time as created_time, o.updated_time as updated_time

and ( (json_unquote(json_extract(o.payload_json, '$.routeType')) = 'OA_SIGN_HR_TASK' and o.recipient_user_id = t.assigned_hr_user_id) or (json_unquote(json_extract(o.payload_json, '$.routeType')) = 'OA_SIGN_PACKAGE_SIGN' and o.recipient_user_id = t.employee_id) )
mapper.insert: insert ignore into oa_sign_notification_outbox ( channel, recipient_user_id, business_key, payload_json, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, last_result, last_error, version, created_time, updated_time ) values ( #{channel}, #{recipientUserId}, #{businessKey}, #{payloadJson}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{lastResult}, #{lastError}, #{version}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.select:
select from oa_sign_notification_outbox o inner join oa_sign_task t on t.task_id = cast(json_unquote(json_extract(o.payload_json, '$.taskId')) as unsigned) where (( o.status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY') and (o.next_retry_time is null or o.next_retry_time <= #{dueTime}) ) or ( o.status = 'SENDING' and o.updated_time <= #{staleSendingBefore} ))
order by coalesce(o.next_retry_time, o.created_time), o.outbox_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update oa_sign_notification_outbox set status = 'SENT', next_retry_time = null, last_result = #{lastResult}, last_error = null, version = version + 1, updated_time = sysdate() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = 'SENDING' and version = #{version}

update oa_sign_notification_outbox set status = 'RETRY', retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_result = null, last_error = #{lastError}, version = version + 1, updated_time = sysdate() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = 'SENDING' and version = #{version}

update oa_sign_notification_outbox set status = 'DEAD', next_retry_time = null, last_result = null, last_error = #{lastError}, version = version + 1, updated_time = sysdate() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = 'SENDING' and version = #{version}
mapper.select:
select from oa_sign_notification_outbox o inner join oa_sign_task t on t.task_id = cast(json_unquote(json_extract(o.payload_json, '$.taskId')) as unsigned) and t.task_id = #{taskId} where 1 = 1
order by o.updated_time desc, o.outbox_id desc limit 1

select p.package_id from oa_sign_package p inner join oa_sign_task t on t.task_id = p.task_id and t.package_id = p.package_id and t.employee_id = p.employee_id and t.shop_dept_id = p.shop_dept_id and t.plan_version_id = p.plan_version_id inner join oa_sign_plan_version v on v.version_id = p.plan_version_id and v.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' where p.package_id = #{candidate.packageId} and p.task_id = #{candidate.taskId} and p.employee_id = #{candidate.employeeId} and p.shop_dept_id = #{candidate.shopDeptId} and t.assigned_hr_user_id = #{candidate.assignedHrUserId} and p.status = #{candidate.packageStatus} and p.sign_deadline = #{candidate.signDeadline} and t.sign_deadline = p.sign_deadline and p.sign_deadline > #{enqueueTime} and p.deadline_policy_source is not null and trim(p.deadline_policy_source) != '' and t.deadline_policy_source is not null and trim(t.deadline_policy_source) != '' and p.deadline_days_snapshot > 0 and t.deadline_days_snapshot = p.deadline_days_snapshot and ( (#{candidate.reminderStage} = 'INITIAL' and ((p.status = 'pending_sign' and t.status = 'PENDING_SIGN') or (p.status = 'part_viewed' and t.status = 'VIEWED')) and BINARY p.document_version = BINARY #{candidate.activeDocumentVersion}) or (#{candidate.reminderStage} = 'FINAL' and p.status = 'pending_final_confirm' and t.status = 'PENDING_FINAL_CONFIRM' and BINARY p.final_document_version = BINARY #{candidate.activeDocumentVersion}) ) limit 1 for update
mapper.update: update oa_sign_notification_outbox o inner join oa_sign_task t on t.task_id = cast(json_unquote(json_extract(o.payload_json, '$.taskId')) as unsigned) and t.task_id = #{taskId} set o.status = 'PENDING', o.retry_count = 0, o.next_retry_time = null, o.last_result = 'MANUAL_REQUEUE', o.last_error = null, o.version = o.version + 1, o.updated_time = sysdate() where o.outbox_id = #{outboxId} and o.status = 'DEAD' and o.version = #{version} and t.assigned_hr_user_id = #{hrUserId}
mapper.delete: delete from oa_sign_notification_outbox where cast(json_unquote(json_extract(payload_json, '$.taskId')) as unsigned) = #{taskId}
